name: vlm_benchmark_real_images
description: A collection for evaluating vision–language models on tasks grounded in real images. It provides real-image inputs and associated prompts/questions to measure model capabilities such as visual question answering and image-language understanding under real visual conditions. Evaluation typically includes task-specific metrics (e.g., accuracy for VQA, language metrics for captioning).
evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (accuracy for VQA; BLEU/ROUGE/CIDEr or other captioning metrics for generation tasks)
general_score_metric: Accuracy (for VQA tasks) / BLEU or CIDEr (for captioning)
reputation: A smaller community dataset on Hugging Face for evaluating VLMs on real images; modest usage compared to larger standardized VQA/captioning benchmarks.
